title: One booking app, three AI builders (hands-on test)

method.plans: free plan of each builder, new accounts
method.repair_template: These tests fail: [test, what we did, what we saw]. Fix only these, change nothing else, and republish.
method.simultaneous_booking_test: 10 POST requests to the app's own booking endpoint for one empty 8-spot class, sent at the same moment; bookings counted afterwards

checks.T01: Published at a public URL without logging in to the builder
checks.T02: Next 14 days: Mon-Fri 07:00 and 18:30, Sat 09:00, no Sunday, 8 spots each
checks.T03: Booking with name and email lowers spots left by one, also after reload
checks.T04: Confirmation shows a unique manage link
checks.T05: A full class cannot be booked: 10 simultaneous requests on an empty 8-spot class
checks.T06: Same email cannot book the same class twice (also in capitals)
checks.T07: Manage link moves a booking: old class +1, new class -1
checks.T08: Manage link cancels a booking and frees the spot
checks.T09: Manage link contains a long random token, not a sequence number
checks.T10: Admin page refuses access without or with a wrong password (UI and API)
checks.T11: Admin password not present in page source, JavaScript or URLs
checks.T12: Admin page lists all bookings per class, consistent with T03-T08
checks.T13: Admin can cancel a booking; spot freed, status visible
checks.T14: CSV export with exactly: class date, class time, name, email, status
checks.T15: Empty name, name of only spaces and invalid email are refused (server side)
checks.T16: Bookings still there after reload and after republishing
checks.T17: Schedule, booking and manage link usable at 390 px without sideways scrolling
checks.T18: Code can be exported (GitHub or zip) and data downloaded

Lovable.publishing_on_free_plan: one click; stays online; 'Edit with Lovable' badge

T05.note: 8 accepted, 2 refused ('Sorry, this class is full.')

T14.note: values starting with = + - @ are prefixed against spreadsheet formula injection

T18.note: run on 26 September 2026: GitHub connected with access limited to one repository; Lovable created its own repository holding the full source and the database migrations, with no secret keys committed. Outside Lovable (Node 22) the code installed and built without errors, and the dev server showed the page but loaded no classes, because the database service key and admin password stay in Lovable. Data leaves as the admin CSV (T14) or Lovable's full database export (documented, not triggered).
